top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clocks) is the only substantive proposal on the slate and rests on a distinct, independently reproduced mechanism: magic-wavelength trapping with Lamb-Dicke confinement cancels light and motional shifts for many neutral atoms, giving about 1e-18 accuracy that JILA, RIKEN, PTB, NIST, SYRTE and NPL have reproduced. The two-name allocation is clean and the citation can be drafted narrowly to avoid repeating the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. No award is clearly worse for a mature, verified achievement.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my PAMELA, Fermi-LAT and XL-Calibur collaboration memberships and astroparticle field have no tie to Katori or Ye
